objective: Pitfalls measured per problem kind (package 16.14): on each tabular kind's replica (binary, multiclass, regression, places, text_tabular), three seeds, the wrong way against the right way on the same rows: a random split against the kind's own split (the latest rows by time; whole blocks of places), five random draws averaged; and the replica's planted leak kept in against left out. Each result is the mean gap with a t interval over the seeds.
rule: Invented replica data with its traps planted and one model family with default settings: the size of an effect on a real table differs. A random split that does not flatter a replica (little drift over time) is reported as measured, not as a rule about real tables.
